name: invented3
idea: A bounded (tag → line) LRU table of recently-referenced cache lines emits a fixed-degree, same-page forward stride on every touch. Because it keys on the accessed line rather than the PC, it survives the 17–23k distinct-PC explosion and the pointer/loop patterns where per-PC stride history breaks, catching the >8-line strided and cross-page-reuse accesses the current PC-centric stack misses — and
